sharingHelp: Grant another device access when someone joins your work. Copying files to a host does not grant it access.
memberAccess: Members can read and edit every lab book, record, attachment and saved version in this workspace, and authorize others.
authorizeSelf: Authorize this device for passwordless access
verifiedGrant: I verified the recipient’s fingerprint and grant full access to this workspace.
recoveryConfigured: A recovery key is configured. Keep it separately from this workspace.
recoveryCreateHelp: Create a recovery key so you can regain access if you lose your device or password.
successorHelp: Create a private successor with a new encryption key, then authorize its members. Previous members retain access to earlier copies; they cannot open the new workspace unless invited.
requestTooLarge: The access request is too large.
validRequest: Enter a valid Observanda device request.
selfAuthorized: This device can now reopen the workspace.
recoveryPower: The recovery key grants full access without a device or password. Save it in a separate secure place.
oldRecovery: The old key will stop opening the current access file. Earlier backups can still be opened with their earlier recovery keys.
verifyRecipient: Check the recipient request and verify its fingerprint.
deviceAuthorized: Device authorized. Share the complete encrypted workspace folder with the recipient.
recoveryShownOnce: This key is shown once. Save it outside the workspace, such as in a password manager or a secure offline location.
legacyPassword: This workspace has an earlier app sign-in password. Its files are still readable outside Observanda.
readableFolder: Anyone with access to this folder can read its contents.
waitUpload: Wait for the media upload to finish.
savePublishing: Save or discard the publishing destination edits first.
encryptedOpened: Encrypted copy verified and opened. The original remains in its previous folder.
storageSubtitle: Workspace files, encryption and access settings.
storageDataHelp: Records, module data, drafts, settings and evidence manifests are encrypted in PostgreSQL. Original evidence files, prepared media and access keys remain in the workspace folder. Use Copy workspace to include both in a verified backup.
readableExports: Website previews stay in memory. Downloaded websites and result sheets are readable exports.
encryptedDataHelp: Records, history, laboratory data and private settings are encrypted in PostgreSQL; original attachments and prepared media are encrypted in the workspace folder.
visiblePathsHelp: Storage paths and file sizes remain visible. Configure a separate recovery key before relying on one device.
encryptedCopyHelp: Create an encrypted copy to protect all records, revisions and attachments. The original remains in place for you to manage after verification.
encryptHelp: All research files and history will be encrypted with a new key in the new folder. Existing device grants and recovery keys will not carry over. The original stays unchanged and accessible to its existing members.
encryptPasswordHelp: Use at least 12 characters for a password. Where device protection is available, leave it blank to authorize this device. Configure recovery in the new workspace.
storageHint: Use an empty folder on this computer, an external drive, or a connected network/NAS share.
encryptedCopySharing: Create encrypted copy with sharing & recovery
passwordChanges: Password changes keep data encrypted and sign out other sessions. Other authorized devices retain access. Setting a password removes passwordless access for this device.
deviceBlank: Leave both new password fields blank to use this device instead.

encryptReady.one: Ready to encrypt {count} file ({megabytes} MB). The original stays in place.
encryptReady.other: Ready to encrypt {count} files ({megabytes} MB). The original stays in place.

locationResearch: Research records, projects, themes and pages
